verdict.rationale: Skills ship SKILL.md frontmatter that states both what the skill does and when it triggers. The tdd skill says "Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions 'red-green-refactor'…", grilling says "Use when the user wants to stress-test their thinking", and setup says "Run once before first use." The aihero.dev catalog adds a one-line purpose for each skill, and a runtime probe confirmed installed SKILL.md frontmatter reads back cleanly. Missing for 10: activation-trigger text evidenced for only about 3 of the 25–27 skills (triage shows only a purpose line), and no independent confirmation that every skill carries trigger documentation.
